name: How do I know if my home has an existing gas line for a range?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my home has an existing gas line for a range?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can check for an existing gas line by looking behind the location where your range will be placed. Typically, a gas line will terminate with a shut-off valve and a capped pipe or a flexible connector. If you don't see one, or if you're unsure, it's best to consult with a licensed plumber. They can safely inspect your home's gas infrastructure and confirm whether a connection is present or if a new line needs to be installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a shut-off valve and a capped pipe behind the range location. If unsure, a licensed plumber can confirm if a gas line exists.
